# Toro Showcases New Residential Outdoor Power Equipment at Equip Expo


### Powerful lineup includes new limited edition ‘Longhorn’ TITAN® MAX MyRIDE®


Oct 14, 2026 |[Homeowner](https://newsroom.toro.com/en/homeowner)


-
-
-


Toro is showcasing small and mighty residential solutions at Equip Expo in Louisville, Kentucky October 20-23. Each new product is engineered to provide homeowners with compact, powerful and efficient performance to maintain their outdoor spaces — no matter the season.


“Smaller equipment no longer means less powerful with this lineup. Whether it’s a mower that takes care of your yard while you kick up your feet, or providing full-sized power in a compact frame that doesn’t take up all of your garage space, Toro is proving that smaller actually is better,” says Lisa Bloomer, senior director of marketing for Toro’s Residential and Landscape Contractor Division. “To celebrate the joy of lawncare, we’re also launching a special, limited edition zero turn mower this spring that encapsulates everything it means to own a Toro: power, precision and pride.”


**New Robotic Mower**


The introduction of the Toro HAVEN® AM75 Autonomous Mower offers homeowners a new opportunity to take care of their lawn without lifting a finger. This easy-to-use autonomous solution cuts and maintains properties up to three-quarters of an acre. It takes less time to set up than a typical mow, and best of all, it's your final shift on yard duty. Its LiDAR-guided navigation and 360-degree environmental awareness allow it to map lawns, detect obstacles in real-time, and navigate safely around them. Whether using auto-mapping for defined borders or the mobile app for custom boundaries and exclusion zones, homeowners can enjoy a pristine, always-ready lawn without manual labor. Backed by Toro’s trusted heritage, the HAVEN AM75 is Toro’s answer to busy lives — set it up once and reclaim your weekends permanently.


**New 24-inch Power Max** ®


**HD Two-Stage Snow Blower**


The new 24-inch Power Max HD is built to clear faster and never quit, with full heavy-duty power in a compact footprint. At its core is a commercial-grade steel gearbox that’s 2X stronger than shear pin designs, giving you the toughest powertrain in its class.§ Toro’s exclusive anti-clog intake keeps heavy, wet snow moving through the chute, stopping clogs before they start. Enhancements include an all-metal Quick Stick® chute control for instant adjustments, maintenance-free Never-Flat airless tires, and an ultra-wide LED light bar paired with a new footwell light for 360-degree visibility. Compact build, full-power and ready to take on winter’s toughest snowfall.


**Compact 50-inch TimeCutter®**


**Zero Turn Mower**


Speaking of compact, the redesigned 50-inch TimeCutter® brings serious cutting power to properties up to two acres with a new, smaller footprint engineered to take up 20% less storage space than comparable TimeCutter MAX models*. Combining a narrow chassis with powerful twin-cylinder performance and a durable fabricated deck, this mower maximizes cutting width without taking up extra space in the garage. The refreshed model incorporates commercial-grade upgrades including pro-inspired styling with a bold, sculpted front-end design, aggressive tire treads for enhanced traction and stability, and a high-back seat with custom bolstering for superior operator support. Additionally, a new low-step entry design ensures effortless access. Big performance doesn’t have to come with a big footprint.


**Limited Edition TITAN** ®


**MAX MyRIDE** ®


**Zero Turn Mower**


Some machines are a rare breed. The new TITAN MAX MyRIDE Longhorn edition is one of them. Built on Toro’s pro-grade TITAN MAX platform, featuring a powerful 25 hp commercial engine and MyRIDE suspension system, the Longhorn Edition pairs proven performance with a distinctive, blacked-out design: a custom seat, alloy rims and unique Longhorn bull badging. Just 1,000 will be produced, each finished with a serialized, limited edition plate. Look out for more details on when these special zero turn mowers will be available at authorized Toro retailers.


Big, small, or built to stand out, discover how Toro’s mightiest lineup yet can transform your yard. To see all of Toro’s offerings in person, stop by indoor booth 7148 and outdoor booth 7600D at Equip Expo, or visit[toro.com](http://toro.com/) for more information.


Trina Lundblad | Homeowner (Equipment) |952-887-7146 |trina.lundblad@toro.com


##### About Toro


With roots dating back to 1914, Toro is a leading worldwide provider of innovative solutions for the outdoor environment including turf and landscape maintenance, snow management, rental and construction equipment, and irrigation solutions. Through a strong network of distributors, dealers, retailers and rental stores in more than 125 countries, Toro helps customers care for golf courses, sports fields, public green spaces, commercial and residential properties, construction sites and agricultural operations.
